from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

p = Path('.runtime/project_executor_canary_e001.txt')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = 'Capability-scoped Prediction project executor ran Python in WSL.\n'
p.write_text(payload, encoding='utf-8')
readback = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('PROJECT_EXECUTOR_CANARY=PASS')
print(f'ARTIFACT={p.resolve()}')
print(f'READBACK={readback.strip()}')
print(f'SHA256={hashlib.sha256(readback.encode()).hexdigest()}')

notes: Harmless Tier-A runtime canary: writes only inside an isolated worktree, executes repository-owned Python under the project guard, and inspects local Git status.
